title: Korah's Rebellion

questions.question: Who led the rebellion against Moses and Aaron?
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:1 (ESV): "Now Korah... and Dathan and Abiram... took men..."

questions.question: What did the rebels say to Moses and Aaron?
options: "You have gone too far! For all in the congregation are holy."
questions.correctAnswer: "You have gone too far! For all in the congregation are holy."
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:3 (ESV): "You have gone too far! For all in the congregation are holy, every one of them..."

questions.question: How did God punish Korah, Dathan, and Abiram?
options: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up
questions.correctAnswer: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:32 (ESV): "And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up..."

questions.question: What happened to the 250 men offering incense?
options: Fire came out from the Lord and consumed them
They were swallowed by the earth
questions.correctAnswer: Fire came out from the Lord and consumed them
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:35 (ESV): "And fire came out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men offering the incense."

questions.question: What did Aaron do to stop the plague that started the next day?
options: He stood between the dead and the living with incense
questions.correctAnswer: He stood between the dead and the living with incense
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:47-48 (ESV): "And he put on the incense and made atonement... and he stood between the dead and the living..."

questions.question: How many people died in the plague?
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:49 (ESV): "Now those who died in the plague were 14,700..."

questions.question: What tribe was Korah from?
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:1 (ESV): "Korah the son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi..."

questions.question: What tribes were Dathan and Abiram from?
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:1 (ESV): "...Dathan and Abiram... sons of Reuben..."

questions.question: What was done with the bronze censers of the 250 men?
options: They were hammered into a covering for the altar
questions.correctAnswer: They were hammered into a covering for the altar
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:38-39 (ESV): "Let them be made into hammered plates as a covering for the altar..."

questions.question: Why specifically were the censers kept as a sign?
options: To be a reminder that no one who is not a priest should draw near to burn incense
questions.correctAnswer: To be a reminder that no one who is not a priest should draw near to burn incense
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:40 (ESV): "To be a reminder... that no outsider, who is not of the descendants of Aaron, should draw near to burn incense..."

questions.question: Moses said, "If these men die as all men do... then...?"
options: The Lord has not sent me
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord has not sent me
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:29 (ESV): "If these men die as all men do... then the Lord has not sent me."

questions.question: What new thing did Moses say the Lord would create?
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:30 (ESV): "But if the Lord creates something new, and the ground opens its mouth..."

questions.question: Who warned Dathan and Abiram's tents to be avoided?
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:26 (ESV): "And he (Moses) spoke to the congregation, saying, 'Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men...'"

questions.question: What did Korah accuse Moses and Aaron of doing "above the assembly"?
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:3 (ESV): "Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the Lord?"

questions.question: Moses said Korah sought what office?
questions.explanation: Numbers 16:10 (ESV): "...and would you seek the priesthood also?"

key_verse_text: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households and all the people who belonged to Korah and all their goods.
